broken and flash (Report if this happens to you)[/p][/*][/list][h2][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] Chronos Arena Art Update[/h2][list][*][p][b]Mainline[/b][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/a438dada8e9402507577614ccd967b942482f5ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/9d1fc103b58858047a7406710432ceb2b6337b75.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] Champion Stats[/h2][list][*][p]Right-click a champion to see all the details and stats[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/2c247b3a3849a71c7713a0d5bce1104995bc8f25.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] Summon Stats[/h2][list][*][p]Right-click a summon to see all the details and stats[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/172c83340c3ccd9712ad68a5eea73b38150fa151.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2][i][b]UPDATE[/b][/i] Game Mode[/h2][p]Players can no longer perform any actions while in the pregame dugout phase.[/p][p]The following changes around the game mode are to balance some inconsistencies we have been seeing with the flow of the game.[/p][p]We want to discourage players from diving at the goalie, so we are making an update to the goalie's targeting, movement, and damage.[/p][p]We want to encourage playing summons more strategically around the Goalie to get maximum damage.[/p][p]The goalie not clearing summons on KO really helps the push stay active and incentivizes the defenders to actually defend instead of just letting the goalie go down to clear the summons.[/p][p]Keeping the mana aura in play all game helps balance out the goalie not clearing summons on KO.[/p][p]Overall, these changes will help the defender and the attacker in different ways throughout a match.[/p][list][*][p][b]Goalie[/b][/p][list][*][p]Movement speed changed from 400 → 600[/p][/*][*][p]Damage changed from 45 → 75[/p][/*][*][p]No longer clears summons on Goalie KO[/p][/*][*][p]Targeting now prioritizes summons[/p][/*][*][p]Can switch targets after each attack[/p][/*][*][p]Counter added on the HUD to show how many times a Goalie has been KO’d[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Core health changed from 3000 → 4000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Aura[/b][/p][list][*][p]Is no longer attached to the Goalie[/p][/*][*][p]Aura is now stationary around the Goalie/ Core spawn point all the time[/p][/*][*][p]When the Core is broken, it will clear all enemy summons in the Aura[/p][/*][*][p]Summons can NOT target the Goalie unless they are within the aura[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Champion KOs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now grants 10% ultimate charge[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Champions now respawn with 4 mana[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Wild Card Visual Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Is now an in-world timer[/p][/*][*][p]Health of the Wild Card has been added[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/a2ca02155e21f5f7e7a15ca362f89f0ee91dff42.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tab Screen Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full Decks are now displayed[/p][/*][*][p]The screen is now a toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Hover cards for details[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/94bbab01e582b31f88049f2f46d2e18415f0798f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Victory Screen Update[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/de4b52e38a7f77e45c491eac9d6e7151927eaa48.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Post Game AAR Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional stats have been added[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/1fc0b6fc532a8f9776c42d21bc7df7fe34fc462e.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]Knockback[/h2][list][*][p]Knockback is getting a nerf in the damage category because its strength is in the crowd control, not the damage. Anything that has knockback will see a damage increase because of this.[/p][/*][*][p]Fall distance damage changed from .03 → .01[/p][/*][/list][h2][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] Guardian Keyword[/h2][p]When a guardian is the target of a champion's attack, it will take 100% damage, and everything else hit will take 50% damage.[/p][p]When a guardian is not the main target of a champion's attack, it will take 50% damage.[/p][list][*][p]Summons With the Keyword[/p][list][*][p]Infernus[/p][/*][*][p]Janz[/p][/*][*][p]Floraphant[/p][/*][*][p]Gorrit[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Summons[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where they would not target correctly on ramps[/p][/*][/list][h3]Hornelius[/h3][list][*][p]Movement speed changed from 600 → 700[/p][/*][*][p]Attack cooldown changed from 4.5s → 3s[/p][/*][*][p]Damage changed from 5 → 50[/p][/*][/list][h3]Pocus[/h3][list][*][p]Damage changed from 5 → 25[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown changed from 4 → 6[/p][/*][/list][h3]Slowclaw[/h3][list][*][p]Damage changed from 30 → 75[/p][/*][/list][h3]Infernus[/h3][list][*][p]Health changed from 450 → 375[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Ignite stacks changed from 40 → 20[/p][/*][/list][h3]Shortfuse[/h3][list][*][p]Mana changed from 2 → 3[/p][/*][*][p]Radius changed from 8m → 4m[/p][/*][/list][h3]Blitzbois[/h3][list][*][p]Health changed from 85 → 125[/p][/*][*][p]Starting Damage changed from 1 → 20[/p][/*][*][p]Full Blitz Damage changed from 100 → 60[/p][/*][/list][h3]Badaboom[/h3][list][*][p]Mana changed from 4 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Health changed from 200 → 150[/p][/*][*][p]Starting Damage changed from 1 → 25[/p][/*][*][p]Inner Radius Damage set to 250[/p][/*][*][p]Outer Radius Damage set to 25[/p][/*][/list][h3]Zip Zap[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where it would target and shoot through the floor[/p][/*][/list][h3]Floraphant[/h3][list][*][p]Health changed from 550 → 500[/p][/*][*][p]Full Blitz Damage changed from 400 → 300[/p][/*][/list][h2]Champions[/h2][list][*][p]Cooldowns are adjusted on champions to fit the flow of intended combat per champion better.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump velocities are lowered so champions stay in melee and sight range of other players better.[/p][list][*][p]With this, we removed the horizontal slowdown from jump spamming[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Scrap and talent pick-ups have been tweaked to be instant[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bolgar[/h3][p]Bolgar was stacking knockback power a little to much with talents and wildcards so we are bringing that down a little across the board.[/p][list][*][p]Stampede talent knockback power changed from 5 → 3[/p][/*][*][p]Wide Bore talent knockback power changed from 5.5 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Packleader's Boon talent now ignores himself[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer jump while sprinting[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability damage changed from 5 → 20[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability cooldown changed from 15s → 20s[/p][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 2800 → 1900[/p][/*][*][p]Melee damage from 15 → 20[/p][/*][*][p]Werebear damage from 20 → 30[/p][/*][*][p]Super Werebear from 30 → 40[/p][/*][*][p]Can now be knocked back in Super Werebear[/p][/*][/list][h3]Neva[/h3][p]We didn’t like how Neva could abuse the use of going in and out of her Ultimate, so we are changing when the Ultimate can be used.[/p][p]We saw that the hack was not lasting long enough to be impactful, and at times would not reach where you thought it would.[/p][list][*][p]Ultimate can no longer activate at 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Early Access talent changed from activating from 25% → 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability mechanical hack duration changed from 4s → 6s[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability silence duration changed from 1.5s → 3s[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability range changed from 10m → 12.5m[/p][/*][*][p]Neva's special ability cooldown from 20s → 25s[/p][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 1800 → 1550[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Neva would get stuck with low gravity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Neva's mech would stay on the field[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Neva would come out of her ultimate with XO on[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you can move while transforming into the ultimate[/p][/*][/list][h3]Locke[/h3][p]Volt was being used a lot more than intended, with the amount of damage it was dealing. We want to slow the use of Volt but also change the base damage to do less per target. Whereas the talent to Crit will bring that damage up.[/p][list][*][p]Volt damage from 50 → 25[/p][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 1900 → 1800[/p][/*][*][p]Gravity changed from 4 → 5[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability cooldown from 25s → 20s[/p][/*][*][p]Movement ability cooldown from 8s → 10s[/p][/*][*][p]Sidekick ability cooldown from 15s → 22s[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Locke’s melee would hit twice[/p][/*][*][p]Can now always jump, and you have to hold to hover[/p][list][*][p]To stop hovering, you have to wait for the time to run out or use another ability[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where his ultimate would not charge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ultimate would get canceled while activating[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ragna[/h3][p]We saw that Ragna was not keeping up with other champions as well as we wanted, so we are tuning the fire damage up on her across the board.[/p][list][*][p]Dash ignite stacks changed from 9 → 15[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability ignite stacks changed from 25 → 45[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate ignite stacks changed from 160 → 90 per hit[/p][list][*][p]Now has 2 hits[/p][/*][*][p]First at 1.12s[/p][/*][*][p]Second at 2.3s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 2800 → 2000[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where singe would stay around after a KO[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Alpha 3 is Here!
notes.content:
ALPHA 3 IS HERE!
We are kicking off playtesting for Alpha 3 this weekend, while the team is at LVL UP, and have extended playtest hours to get more players into the game! 

[u][b]Extended Playtesting Hours for this Week:[/b][/u]
4/25: 5pm - 11pm CST  (April 25, 10:00 PM – April 26, 4:00 AM UTC)
4/26 11am- 6pm CST  (April 26, 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM UTC)

[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]  
[h2][i]4.25 Update[/i][/h2]  

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Can now see champion abilities in the TAB/Select screen in-game  
[*]All dashes are immune to slows while dashing  
[i]Players were experiencing getting double slowed, so using a dash to cleanse a slow was not working as intended.[/i]  
[*]All Ultimates are immune to slows while activating  
[i]Since ultimates are no longer immune to damage, if a player is slowed while using an ultimate, it’s too hard of a counter to shut it down and KO the player.[/i]  
[*]Now immune when walking out of the dugout for 2 seconds  
[*]Can cast and use abilities once having left the dugout  
[/list]

[h2]WILDCARDS[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Changed from [b]5 → 3[/b] in a deck  
[*]When a Wildcard is captured, a [b]90-second timer[/b] will start  
[*]If the timer runs out, the Wildcards are removed from the players  
[*]If a player is KO’d, the Wildcards are removed from them  
[*]If a player gets a KO, the timer is increased by [b]10 seconds[/b]  
[*]If a player picks up a new Wildcard, the timer resets to [b]90 seconds[/b]  
[/list]

[h2]CHAMPIONS[/h2]

[h3]Neva[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed bug with her getting stuck  
[*]Fixed bug not being able to use Sidekick  
[*]Fixed bug with XO not returning to her  
[/list]

[h3]Hack Mechanic[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Hack no longer prevents summoning  
[/list]

[h3]Dash[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Now cleanses slows  
[/list]

[h3]Ultimate[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Now Hacks on activation  
[*]Increased movement speed from [b]600 → 900[/b]  
[*]Increased attack speed from [b]0.7 → 1[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Ragna[/h3]  
[b]Sidekick[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Changed from global → [b]50m[/b]  
[/list]

[h2]SUMMONS[/h2]

[h3]Vitadrop[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Lifelink healing changed from [b]50% → 100%[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Broc[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Lifelink healing changed from [b]50% → 100%[/b]  
[*]Damage changed from [b]50 → 35[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Buckshot[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Each consecutive hit increases the damage done to a maximum of [b]100[/b] per shot  
[*]Starting damage is [b]40[/b]  
[*]Increased damage per shot is [b]20[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Lumph[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Replaced instant Overheal with Overheal-over-time ability  
[*]Increased total overhealing done to [b]100 HP over 5 seconds[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]RB-IT[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed a bug where dashing after being hit by RB-IT would not cleanse the Time Dilation  
[/list]

[h3]Burnout[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fire Trail duration decreased from [b]5 → 1 seconds[/b]  
[*]Fire Trail damage increased from [b]35 → 50[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Skye[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed to apply Overclocked all the time  
[*]Fixed to cleanse slows  
[/list]

[h3]Heartburn[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Increased fireball size (radius) by [b]50%[/b]  
[*]Increased fireball travel speed by [b]10%[/b]  
[*]Increased fireball damage [b]40 → 50[/b]  
[*]Fireball now correctly deals [b]FIRE[/b] damage  
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY EFFECTS[/h2]  
[i]The following effects no longer stack:[/i]  
[list]  
[*]Overclocked won't stack  
[*]Enrage won't stack  
[*]Time Dilation won't stack  
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Deck building screen UI updated  
[*]Champion select screen UI updated  
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Goalie Health Bar[/b]  
On occasion, the goalie health bar will not reflect the damage the goalie has taken. It’s a HUD issue only — the goalie will take damage and be KO’d as expected.  

[*][b]End of Match Rewards[/b]  
The rewards UI shown at the end of a match can show [b]+0 coins[/b]. Coins are being awarded as expected, and the coin count does update to reflect your actual rewards.  

[*][b]Challenges[/b]  
The Challenges UI may not update, even though your progress toward completing the challenge is being captured.  
[/list]

We can't wait to see you in the arena and get your feedback! We appreciate your help!

notes.title: Alpha 2 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha 2 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Progression[/h2]

[b]Champion Mastery[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Mastery Track Items
[/list]
[i]The mastery track levels are temporary and will be adjusted throughout Alpha[/i]

[b]Account[/b]
[list]
[*] Update account level items
[/list]
[i]The account levels are temporary and will be adjusted throughout Alpha[/i]

[b]Summons[/b]
[i]Summon Mastery Track is as follows. Each level will adjust the cardʼs look and build on the previous level.[/i]
[list]
[*] Level 2 Metallic Frame Card
[*] Level 3 Frame Break Card
[*] Level 4 3D Card
[*] Level 5 Foil Card
[*] Level 6 Animated Card
[/list]
[b]Packs[/b]
[list]
[*] Rarity pull chance percentages adjusted
[*] Packs now have a guaranteed rarity associated with them
[*] Updated pack opening sequence
[*] New summon leveling sequence
[/list]
[h2]Game Mode[/h2]
[b]Goalie[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved targeting behavior
[*] Increased health
[/list]
[b]Shield[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased health
[/list]
[h2]Deck Building[/h2]
[list][*] Overhaul of the deck building screen
[list]
[*] Now shows summon overview stats
[*] Now shows summon keywords
[*] Now shows summon 3D cards and visuals
[/list]
[*] Added Champion Talents
[/list]
[h2]Party System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can now add friends
[*] Can now create a party
[*] Can now queue as a party
[/list]
[h2]Play Flow[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to support 2v2 better
[*] Now shows your teammate in the selection lobby
[*] Can now select cosmetics for your champion
[/list]
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[i]As we played more with the 2v2 we noticed there were some improvements and changes we needed to make to the overall flow and feel of the combat. It was not fully balanced yet or familiar enough to the players.[/i]

[b]Camera and Champion Position[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved the champion position to the left of the center of the screen
[list]
[*] This is to give a better visual while fighting and throwing cards
[*] This allows us to use the center of the screen for combat and abilities in more ways
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Ultimate Immunity[/b]
[list]
[*] Champions no longer get immunity frames while casting or using ultimate's
[list]
[*] We felt that the ultimates were being used in ways to just get immunity frames and avoid damage. This was also leading to the abilities being used in combat when they were not meant to be used that way.[/list]
[/list]
[b]Reticle[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a reticle so a player knows where they will attack
[*] All attacks and abilities now go to the center of the screen where the reticle is
[*] Hit marks when you hit something
[*] KO indication when you get a KO
[/list]
[b]Opponent Targeting[/b]
[list]
[*] Now has a white outline to show what opponent you will hit
[/list]
[b]Hit Notifications[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the visuals to know when youʼre being hit or hitting something
[*] Hit marks on the reticle
[*] Screen flash
[*] HP bar shake
[/list]
[b]Health Bars[/b]
[list]
[*] Only shown if something is damaged
[/list]
[b]Damage Numbers[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed damage flyoffs in game
[/list]
[b]Outlines and Icons[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved outlines of opponents and teammates
[*] Updated icons to be team champions only
[/list]
[h2]Champions[/h2]
[i]As we dove more into the 2v2 nature of the game we found we needed to make the champions fill a role more. You will find updates to the champions kits to reflect these changes. Each champion also has a more distinct sidekick passive.[/i]

[b]Champion Details View[/b]
[list]
[*] By right clicking on a champion in deck selection you can see the details of a champion
[*] This will show the champions abilities
[*] You can now see the champions mastery track
[/list]

[b]Champion Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] Champions now have talents that can be unlocked by mastering them
[*] A deck can have 3 talents in them
[*] A talent is active on a champion for the whole match
[/list]
[h3]Bolgar[/h3]
[b]House Lubabub[/b]
[list]
[*] Role: Bruiser
[*] Playstyle: Disruptor
[*] Difficulty: ⭐⭐
[*] Health Changed from 350 → 400
[*] Combo 1 Damage changed from 20 → 17
[*] Combo 2 Damage changed from 20 → 17
[*] Combo 3 Damage changed from 25 → 21
[/list]
[b]NEW Sidekick Passive: Bear Claws[/b]
[list]
[*] Each time Bolgar hits an opponent, a bleed is applied for 1 damage per second for 5 seconds
[*] This is to lean into him staying in the fight and pushing the health regen of other champions by another 5 seconds
[/list]

[b]Special: Logzooka[/b]
[list]
[*] Can now be used on the ground
[*] Aims to the reticle
[/list]

[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] Healing Bounty
[list]
[*] Last hitting an opponent spawns a health pickup
[/list]
[*] Stonebreaker
[list]
[*] Bolgarʼs dash knocks back opponents
[/list]
[*] Shockwave Impact
[list]
[*] Gains increased KNOCKBACK power of Logzooka.
[/list]
[*] NEW Reckless Charge
[list]
[*] Gains movement speed for a duration after using Shoulder Bash.
[/list]
[*] NEW Earthshakerʼs Momentum
[list]
[*] Gains bonus attack damage for a duration after using an ability.
[/list]
[*] NEW Thunder Paws
[list]
[*] Burr's attacks apply KNOCKBACK.
[/list]
[*] NEW Bearʼs Fury
[list]
[*] When Burr is active, Bolgar becomes ENRAGED for a duration.
[/list]
[*] NEW Resilient Roar
[list]
[*] Activating Werebear max heals all teammates around Werebear.
[/list]
[*] NEW Dominant Presence
[list]
[*] Activating Werebear ENRAGES nearby teammates for a duration.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Locke[/h3]
[b]House Chronos[/b]
[list]
[*] Role: Duelist
[*] Playstyle: Skirmisher
[*] Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
[*] Health Changed from 175 → 200
[*] Movement Speed Changed from 1200 → 1250
[/list]

[b]NEW Sidekick Passive: Temporal Engine[/b]
[list]
[*] This allows Locke to lean more into the "glass cannonˮ skirmish play style
[*] Locke's engines gain power each time he deals damage and lose power each time he takes damage.
[*] Increases movement speed, attack speed and ultimate charge
[/list]

[b]Special: Hover[/b]
[list]
[*] We felt having the ability to slow opponents two times was not needed and that we could make the hover move valuable for Lockes playstyle
[*] Hovers in the air for a duration, evading opponents and maintaining his Temporal Engine status.
[*] Duration: 10 seconds
[*] Cooldown: 10 seconds
[*] This keeps you in the air long enough to get your health regen back
[/list]

[b]Dash: Chronowarp[/b]
[list]
[*] TIME DILATION (slowed time) duration changed from 2 seconds → 3 seconds
[/list]

[b]Ultimate: Full Send[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed from 260 seconds → 190 seconds
[/list]

[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW Freeflow Channeling
[list]
[*] Activating Full Send causes the next card used to cost 0 Mana.
[/list]
[*] NEW Resourceful Engineer
[list]
[*] When a card is played there is a chance that card is kept in hand.
[/list]
[*] NEW Gear Infusion
[list]
[*] Basic attacks have a chance to apply TIME DIALATION on the third hit.
[/list]
[*] Thunderous Decent
[list]
[*] TIME DIALATION duration increased on dash.
[/list]
[*] Chain Lightning
[list]
[*] Volt's attack has a chance to deal CRITICAL damage to opponents.
[/list]
[*] NEW Aetherial Burst
[list]
[*] Gains OVERSHIELD when using Hover.
[/list]
[*] Evasive Engineering
[list]
[*] Gains OVERSHIELD after using Chronowarp.
[/list]
[*] NEW Chrono Surge
[list]
[*] Full Send charges faster.
[/list]
[*] NEW Ultimate Harvest
[list]
[*] Last hitting an opponent spawns an ultimate charge pickup.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Ragna[/h3]
[b]House Malus[/b]
[list]
[*] Role: Bruiser
[*] Playstyle: Brawler
[*] Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐
[/list]

[b]Special: Fire Kick[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire damage changed from 30 → 45
[/list]

[b]Sidekick: Singe[/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown changed from 90 seconds → 60 seconds
[/list]

[b]Dash: Trail[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Damage changed from 10 → 15
[/list]

[b]Ultimate: Flashfire[/b]
[list]
[*] Ultimate changed from 100 → 80
[*] 10 stacks of fire damage added to ultimate
[/list]

[b]Ultimate Charge: Pyromancer[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Damage Charge Rate changed from 2 per tick → 1 per tick
[/list]

[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW Combustion Surge
[list]
[*] Trail count increased to 5.
[/list]
[*] NEW Inferno Mastery
[list]
[*] Activating Singe heals Ragna and teammates.
[/list]
[*] Flame Rebirth
[list]
[*] On last hit ragna auto heals
[/list]
[*] NEW Eternal Embers
[list]
[*] Singe Cooldown is reduced.
[/list]
[*] NEW Flame Weaving
[list]
[*] Activating Singe IGNITES all opponents on the field.
[/list]
[*] Phoenix Dive
[list]
[*] After using air attack ragna gains temp movement speed
[/list]
[*] NEW Ember Pack
[list]
[*] Singe EMPOWERS for more damage when activated.
[/list]
[*] Searing Bonds
[list]
[*] The duration singe is active is increased
[/list]
[*] NEW Blazing Decent
[list]
[*] Gains EMPOWERED after activating Fire Kick.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Neva[/h3]
[b]House Chronos[/b]
[list]
[*] Role: Duelist
[*] Playstyle: Fighter
[*] Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
[*] Combo 1 Damage changed from 45 → 35
[*] Combo 2 Damage changed from 45 → 35
[*] Attack Speed 1 → 0.75 (Slower)
[/list]

[b]Sidekick: XO[/b]
[list]
[*] Support Bot
[list]
[*] Health 150 → 50
[*] Haste 20% → 10%
[/list]
[*] Melee Bot
[list]
[*] Health 250 → 175
[/list]
[*] Turret Bot
[list]
[*] Health 350 → 100
[*] Damage 25 → 20
[*] Range 30m → 25m
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Special: EMP[/b]
[list]
[*] HACKS or SUPPRESSES opponents in an area for a duration.
[*] Hack turns the mechanical summons to your side for a duration
[*] Suppresses makes the non mechanical summons and champions not be able to use abilities for a duration
[*] Cooldown 35 → 30
[/list]

[b]Dash: Rollout[/b]
[list]
[*] Neva rolls forward, applying Haste to any teammates hit.
[/list]

[b]Ultimate: Mechanized[/b]
[list]
[*] Activation changed from needing 1% → 50%
[/list]

[b]Sidekick Passive: XO Armor[/b]
[list]
[*] XO becomes Neva's exoskeleton providing her with more health and damage.
[*] Neva no longer heals to full health when she regains XO.
[*] When Neva regains XO, she keeps her organic health regeneration state.
[/list]

[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] Neva Talent 1
[list]
[*] Range and duration of EMP is increased.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 2
[list]
[*] Support Bot gains increased health and provides increased OVERCLOCKED.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 3
[list]
[*] Neva can activate Mechanized at 25% charge.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 4
[list]
[*] Ranged Bot gains increased health and increased RANGE.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 5
[list]
[*] Activating Mechanized creates an EMP.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 6
[list]
[*] Solo Neva gains CRITICAL damage.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 7
[list]
[*] Neva gains OVERCLOCKED for a duration after XO returns from being broken.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 8
[list]
[*] XO gains decreased return duration.
[/list]
[*] Neva Talent 9
[list]
[*] Melee Bot gains increased health and increased damage.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Summons[/h2]
[i]All summons have had a pass on them. We felt that they needed changes and enhancements to them to fill the role they are meant to fill. These are the updated summon descriptions:[/i]

[b]Shooticrue[/b]
[list]
[*] Three RANGED drones.
[/list]

[b]Sembler[/b]
[list]
[*] SPAWNS Shooticrue over time gradually taking WEAR & TEAR damage.
[*] Sembler FLEES when attacked.
[/list]

[b]Beakit[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks pass through and damage opponents.
[/list]

[b]Skye[/b]
[list]
[*] Creates a field of OVERCLOCKED (sped up time).
[/list]

[b]Wotchy[/b]
[list]
[*] Guards an area by going out and attacking any opponents within his sight.
[*] Gradually takes WEAR & TEAR damage.
[/list]

[b]Deadeye[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks from a RANGE gradually taking WEAR & TEAR damage. Deadeye FLEES when attacked.
[/list]

[b]Chonodrop[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Creates a field of TIME DILATION when it attacks.
[/list]

[b]Fendor[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, provides an OVERSHIELD to teammates.
[/list]

[b]Janz[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON creates a field of TIME DILATION and damages any opponents in range.
[/list]

[b]Razorpaw[/b]
[list]
[*] ACCELERATES over time dealing CRITICAL damge on impact.
[/list]

[b]RBIT[/b]
[list]
[*] Applies TIME DILATION with it's attacks.
[/list]

[b]TDPL[/b]
[list]
[*] UPGRADES, increasing the amount of TDPL summoned.
[/list]

[b]Zipzap[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks from a RANGE increasing the damage dealt over time.
[/list]

[b]Shellshock[/b]
[list]
[*] Randomly targets opponents with its RANGED attack taking decreased damage while reloading.
[/list]

[b]Flingshot[/b]
[list]
[*] Immobile vent. Gradually takes WEAR & TEAR damage.
[/list]

[b]Lumph[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, overheals any teammates in range.
[/list]

[b]Vitadrop[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Deals LIFELINK damage when it attacks.
[/list]

[b]Slowclaw[/b]
[list]
[*] Swipes its opponents dealing KNOCKBACK.
[/list]

[b]Hornelius[/b]
[list]
[*] KNOCKSBACK its opponents with its attacks.
[/list]

[b]Gorrit[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, KNOCKSBACK and damages any opponents in range.
[/list]

[b]Aloe[/b]
[list]
[*] Heals teammates from a RANGE finding a new teammate once the current one is fully healed.
[/list]

[b]Spord[/b]
[list]
[*] Gradually SPAWNS Trooplets over time.
[/list]

[b]Chonk[/b]
[list]
[*] TAUNTS its opponents.
[/list]

[b]Pocus[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks from a RANGE dealing KNOCKBACK.
[/list]

[b]Buckshot[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks from a RANGE.
[/list]

[b]Broc[/b]
[list]
[*] Deals LIFELINK damage.
[/list]

[b]Cactiking[/b]
[list]
[*] Throws Cacticrue at its opponents from a RANGE. Has THORNS.
[/list]

[b]Floraphant[/b]
[list]
[*] TRAMPLES and has BLITZ.
[/list]

[b]Cacticrue[/b]
[list]
[*] Three Cacti with THORNS.
[/list]

[b]Furble[/b]
[list]
[*] TAUNTS opponents and then FLEES.
[/list]

[b]Badaboom[/b]
[list]
[*] ACCELERATES over time and has BLITZ. ON KO, leaves 4 Punks.
[/list]

[b]Lavadrop[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Creates a lava pool when it attacks.
[/list]

[b]Heartburn[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks at a RANGE.
[/list]

[b]D.F.A.[/b]
[list]
[*] SKILLSHOT, deals damage in a small area.
[/list]

[b]Magmalisk[/b]
[list]
[*] IGNITES with its attacks.
[/list]

[b]Tailblazer[/b]
[list]
[*] Ignites its opponents with a RANGED attack.
[/list]

[b]Burnout[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, ZOOMS leaving a trail of lava behind.
[/list]

[b]Pyrokeet[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks at a RANGE and has REBIRTH.
[/list]

[b]Punks[/b]
[list]
[*] Five RANGED Punks.
[/list]

[b]Grumph[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, ENRAGES any teammates in range.
[/list]

[b]Volcrab[/b]
[list]
[*] Gradually SPAWNS Lavadrops over time.
[/list]

[b]Blitzbois[/b]
[list]
[*] IGNITES opponents and has BLITZ.
[/list]

[b]Infernus[/b]
[list]
[*] ON SUMMON, creates a lava pool. ATTACKS from a RANGE and IGNITES.
[/list]

[b]Shortfuse[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacks from a RANGE dealing damage in an area.
[*] Known Issues: Has no summon animation and can get stuck upon being summoned
[/list]

[b]Rekkit[/b]
[list]
[*] ON KO, leaves one Punk.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Effects[/h2]

[b]Haste[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased haste percent from 20% → 10%
[/list]

[b]Enrage[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed to only increase damage dealt
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]

[b]Controller (UPDATED)[/b]
[list]
[*] X → Special Ability
[*] A → Jump
[*] B → Dash
[*] Y → Sidekick
[*] RT → Attack
[*] LT → Throw Card (Hold to Aim)
[*] RB → Change active card
[*] LB → Change active card
[*] L3 → Interact
[*] LB+RB → Ultimate
[*] Select → Information Screen
[/list]

[b]Keyboard and Mouse (UPDATED)[/b]
[list]
[*] Left Mouse → Attack
[*] SPACE → Jump
[*] SHIFT → Dash
[*] F → Special Ability
[*] E → Sidekick
[*] Right Mouse → Throw a card. Hold to Aim.
[*] Mouse Wheel → Change active card
[*] 1 → Select Card Slot 1
[*] 2 → Select Card Slot 2
[*] 3 → Select Card Slot 3
[*] 4 → Select Card Slot 4
[*] R → Interact
[*] Q → Ultimate
[*] TAB → Information Screen
[/list]

Hey Wildcard fans!

We’re turning up the heat for our weekly playtests—more players are joining as we open the gates even wider. And that’s not all: Alpha 2 is rolling out with fresh updates, improvements, and surprises to discover.

Bem-vindos, jogadores do Brasil! We’re excited to welcome our growing community of Portuguese-speaking players to the Wildcard universe. Stay tuned for more ways to get involved!

[u][b]Alpha 2 Playtest Server Schedule:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Friday @ 6pm ET (19h BRT)
[*] Saturday @ 12pm ET (13h BRT)
[/list]
These weekly Friday/Saturday playtests will continue as we expand access and invite more players each week. Still waiting on your invite? More are on the way—stay tuned to Steam and our community channels for future waves.

[b]Don’t Forget:[/b]
Adding Wildcard to your Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/497120/Wildcard/]Wishlist [/url]is the best way to ensure you never miss an update!

To everyone hopping in—sejam bem-vindos! We can’t wait to see your strategies, hear your feedback, and keep building Wildcard together.

Quer entrar para a família Wildcard?
 Join our [url=https://discord.gg/playwildcard]Discord[/url] to meet the community or open a support ticket if you need a hand!

notes.title: Another Batch of Players Join the Wildcard Closed Alpha!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/e682a5e799fd13e502ea25a9e7252ddcfd6bf3f5.png[/img]

Hey Wildcard fans!

Big news: The second wave of invites to the Wildcard Closed Alpha Playtest has just gone out! If you’ve been selected, check your Steam notifications—you’ll see access to add the Wildcard Playtest to your Steam library and jump in. You’ll also receive an email from Steam with more details.

[u][b]Alpha 1 Playtest Server Schedule:[/b][/u]
 • Friday 3/21 @ 7pm ET (an hour after usual schedule)
 • Saturday 3/22 @ 12pm ET

We’re keeping the cadence going—[b]playtests will continue to run on Fridays (6pm ET) and Saturdays (12pm ET)[/b] as we roll out additional waves of invites and expand access each week.

Haven’t received your invite yet? Don’t worry, more are on the way! Make sure you’re following Wildcard here on Steam and in our community spaces to stay in the loop.

For everyone hopping in this weekend: welcome! We can’t wait to hear your feedback, see your strategies, and shape the future of Wildcard together.

Wanna join the Wild family? Got questions? Come hang with us in [url=https://discord.gg/playwildcard]Discord[/url]!
